world_version.core_version: AzerothCore rev. unknown 1970-01-01 00:00:00 +0000 (Archived branch) (Unix, Release, Static)

source_queries.updates: SELECT name,hash,state FROM updates ORDER BY name
source_queries.profiles: SELECT * FROM playercreateinfo ORDER BY race,class
source_queries.quests:
SELECT q.ID,q.LogTitle,q.QuestLevel,q.MinLevel,q.QuestSortID,
            q.AllowableRaces,q.Flags,q.QuestInfoID,q.StartItem,q.TimeAllowed,
            q.RequiredFactionId1,q.RequiredFactionId2,q.RewardNextQuest,
            a.ProvidedItemCount,a.AllowableClasses,a.PrevQuestID,a.NextQuestID,a.ExclusiveGroup,
            a.BreadcrumbForQuestId,a.SpecialFlags,a.RequiredSkillID,
            a.RequiredMinRepFaction,a.RequiredMaxRepFaction,a.MaxLevel
            FROM quest_template q LEFT JOIN quest_template_addon a USING(ID) ORDER BY q.ID
source_queries.starters:
SELECT s.quest,s.id,t.faction FROM creature_queststarter s
            JOIN creature_template t ON t.entry=s.id ORDER BY s.quest,s.id
source_queries.enders: SELECT quest,id FROM creature_questender ORDER BY quest,id
source_queries.source_items:
SELECT entry,startquest,maxcount FROM item_template
            WHERE entry IN (SELECT StartItem FROM quest_template WHERE StartItem<>0)
            OR startquest<>0 ORDER BY entry
source_queries.conditions:
SELECT * FROM conditions WHERE SourceTypeOrReferenceId IN (19,20)
            ORDER BY SourceTypeOrReferenceId,SourceGroup,SourceEntry,SourceId,ElseGroup,
            ConditionTypeOrReference,ConditionTarget,ConditionValue1,ConditionValue2,ConditionValue3
source_queries.creatures: SELECT entry,name,minlevel,maxlevel,ScriptName FROM creature_template ORDER BY entry
source_queries.spawns: SELECT DISTINCT id,map,spawnMask FROM creature ORDER BY id,map,spawnMask
source_queries.instances: SELECT * FROM instance_template ORDER BY map
source_queries.access: SELECT * FROM dungeon_access_template ORDER BY id
source_queries.event_quests:
SELECT quest FROM game_event_creature_quest UNION
            SELECT quest FROM game_event_gameobject_quest UNION SELECT entry AS quest FROM pool_quest ORDER BY quest
source_queries.levels: SELECT DISTINCT level FROM creature_classlevelstats WHERE level BETWEEN 1 AND 80 ORDER BY level
source_queries.early_crafting_items:
SELECT entry,spellid_1,spellid_2,spellid_3,spellid_4,spellid_5 FROM item_template
            WHERE spellid_1 IN (4954) OR spellid_2 IN (4954) OR spellid_3 IN (4954)
            OR spellid_4 IN (4954) OR spellid_5 IN (4954) ORDER BY entry
source_queries.early_crafting_focuses: SELECT entry,Data0 AS focus FROM gameobject_template WHERE type=8 AND Data0 IN (3) ORDER BY entry
